metadata.description: azd environment name (AZURE_ENV_NAME), e.g. rd-prod. Used for tags and resource name uniqueness.
Primary region (AZURE_LOCATION), e.g. westeurope. Everything lives here except the Maps account and, when SQL_LOCATION is set, the SQL server.
Stage suffix in resource names (rg-runnersdiary-<stage>). Local Aspire is the dev environment; the cloud has prod only.

Optional custom domain for the web app (CUSTOM_DOMAIN). DNS first: CNAME to the web FQDN and TXT asuid.<name> = the environment verification id. A free managed certificate is issued and bound automatically.

Region of the Azure SQL server and database (SQL_LOCATION). Empty = the primary region. West Europe was not accepting new SQL servers for this subscription on 2026-11-04 (RegionDoesNotAllowProvisioning), so prod uses polandcentral (westeurope and northeurope are restricted for this subscription per the SQL capabilities API).
Region of the Azure Maps account. It must support managed identities (not "global"); West/North Europe sit behind eu.atlas.microsoft.com.
Object id of the person running azd (AZURE_PRINCIPAL_ID); gets Key Vault Secrets Officer and optionally Cognitive Services User.
Ai__Enabled kill switch. Stays false until the live eval passed (plan G6 -> G7).
Foundry capacity in thousands of tokens per minute (1 = 1,000 TPM).
Give the azd user Cognitive Services User on Foundry for the live eval from a laptop.
Azure Maps display via SAS tokens (plan G9). Default off: MapLibre + OpenFreeMap, Azure Maps only for geocoding.
E-mail for the budget and alerts. Required; set it with `azd env set BUDGET_CONTACT_EMAIL ...`, never commit it.
First day of a month (yyyy-MM-01). Set once by infra/hooks/preprovision.sh as the azd value BUDGET_START_DATE so re-provisioning does not move the budget.
RaceImport__Enabled kill switch of job-race-import. When false the job exits 0 before touching SQL. azd env RACE_IMPORT_ENABLED.
RaceImport__Sources__RunningLife__Enabled: per-source kill switch. azd env RACE_IMPORT_RUNNING_LIFE.
UTC cron of job-race-import (RACE_IMPORT_CRON). Default is 10 minutes after the guest cleanup so both share one SQL wake; move them together.
Races__Enabled on the api app: feeds client-config races.enabled (the Races UI). azd env RACES_UI_ENABLED.

Numeric GitHub owner and repository ids. When both are set, the federated credential uses GitHub's immutable OIDC subject (repo:<owner>@<ownerId>/<repo>@<repoId>:environment:<env>), which the repository sends (use_immutable_subject). Empty = the name-only subject. Public values: GET /users/<owner> and /repos/<owner>/<repo>.
First provision only: written to Key Vault by the template. infra/hooks/preprovision.sh fills it when the secret does not exist yet.
Set by azd (SERVICE_API_RESOURCE_EXISTS): keep the deployed image instead of resetting to the placeholder.
